category_title: 8-year-old student with ADHD (Combined Type) exhibiting disruptive classroom behaviors and social-emotional challenges
scenario_title: Creative writing during independent work periods
minimal_context: The student is seated at a desk near the back of the room during an independent work period, tasked with producing a creative writing assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our independent creative writing period. Please sit at your desk and begin writing your paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Staring out the window) I prefer to look at clouds rather than do work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to pay attention to your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Fidgeting and standing beside his desk) You always tell me to pay attention. I just get in trouble for talking too much.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How much of your creative writing have you finished?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Blurting out the answer) I only wrote a three-line product! You just don't know how to have fun.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our independent creative writing period. Please sit at your desk and begin writing your paragraphs.

STUDENT: (Staring out the window) I prefer to look at clouds rather than do work.

TUTOR: You need to pay attention to your assignment.

STUDENT: (Fidgeting and standing beside his desk) You always tell me to pay attention. I just get in trouble for talking too much.

TUTOR: How much of your creative writing have you finished?

STUDENT: (Blurting out the answer) I only wrote a three-line product! You just don't know how to have fun.

task.learning_goal: producing writing products of acceptable length

context.environment: academic subjects during classroom instruction while seated at a desk near the back of the room, and he faced away from the area where Ms. S most frequently addressed the class
context.materials: disorganization of materials, token system sheets listing five writing goals, boxes next to the list writing goals, school-based reward menu

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: during independent work periods and creative writing
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: produced a three-line product as compared with the two paragraphs completed by most of his peers, engaged in a high level of motor activity (e.g., fidgeting, standing beside his desk), impulsivity (e.g., blurting out answers to questions)
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: tended to minimize how disruptive his own behavior was to his learning

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: inattention (e.g., staring out the window, disorganization of materials), frequently sought out attention from his peers by resorting to comical and “class clown”–type behaviors
behavior_patterns.internal_state: preferred to “look at clouds” rather than do work
related_quotes: [got] in trouble for talking too much
